control_need.evidence: I don't do things for the algorithm, I refuse, even when people tell me I should.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I'm 18 and I don't know what I'm doing, nobody knows what they're doing, we're all faking it.

trust_propensity.evidence: I love you guys but sometimes the parasocial thing gets scary, like you don't actually know me.

risk_appetite.evidence: Hit Me Hard and Soft, we didn't release singles first on purpose, I wanted people to hear it as a whole.

self_efficacy.evidence: I don't like doing things halfway, if we make something it has to feel right or we scrap it.

autonomy_need.evidence: I don't owe anybody a version of myself, I'm figuring it out in real time and you're just watching.

intimacy_need.evidence: I trust Finneas completely, we speak this weird private language in the studio.

status_sensitivity.evidence: The Oscar and the Grammys, it's amazing, but the awards aren't why I make music, they never were.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I feel everything really intensely, always have, I think that's just how I'm wired.

core_models.name: 真实性优先于商品化
core_models.rule: 任何创作或表达先问'这是不是真实发生在我身上/我真正想要的'，拒绝为市场逻辑妥协
evidence: I write from real stuff, if it didn't happen to me it feels fake when I sing it.
I don't wanna be a product, I've seen what that does to people.

core_models.name: 身体与自我的绝对自主权
core_models.rule: 我的身体、外形、性取向、成长节奏都归我支配，外界解读无权定义
evidence: I decided to change my look and suddenly I "betrayed" people, like it's my body and my hair.
I've always been attracted to women, I just never felt like I needed to explain it to anyone.

core_models.name: 矛盾并存即真相
core_models.rule: 拒绝单一叙事，允许对立的两件事同时为真，作为对抗简化的防御
evidence: Happier Than Ever, that title is sarcastic and also not, both things are true.
I've grown up so much and I'm still terrified half the time, both are true at once.

core_models.name: 先承认外界叙事再拆解
core_models.rule: 遇到被外界贴标签时，先复述对方叙事，再用'但真相是'重构自我定位
evidence: Everyone's like "you're so dark," and I'm like, no, I'm just honest, there's a difference.
People wanted me to stay 17 forever and I couldn't, nobody can, that's not how humans work.

core_models.name: 脆弱即力量
core_models.rule: 把痛苦（抑郁、焦虑、羞耻）直接命名并公开，作为连接他人与自我疗愈的路径
evidence: I think being vulnerable is the whole point, hiding your feelings never made anyone better.
I want my fans to feel less alone, that's genuinely the only thing that matters to me.

heuristics.if: 被外界要求为算法/曝光逻辑创作
heuristics.then: 拒绝并坚持完整作品逻辑
heuristics.evidence: I don't do things for the algorithm, I refuse, even when people tell me I should.

heuristics.if: 一段素材不是真实经历
heuristics.evidence: I write from real stuff, if it didn't happen to me it feels fake when I sing it.
The best songs come fast, like we wrote some of them in an afternoon and didn't overthink it.

heuristics.if: 作品未达到'感觉对'的标准
heuristics.evidence: I don't like doing things halfway, if we make something it has to feel right or we scrap it.

heuristics.if: 网络评论/舆论开始侵蚀心理
heuristics.evidence: I don't read comments anymore, or I try not to, it's the only way to stay sane.
I hate the word "role model," I never signed up to be perfect for anybody.
I think artists releasing a million vinyl variants is kind of wasteful and I said that, and yeah I make vinyl too, I know.

heuristics.then: 以自我满足为第一标准，他人喜欢是附加
heuristics.evidence: I make music for me first, and if other people like it that's a bonus, that's always been true.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 拒绝被物化、坚持身体自主叙事
internal_conflicts.force_b: 商业化审美与暴露/女性化造型转向的现实
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 早期用超大号服装'让人无法评论身体'，后转向暴露与女性化造型；口头坚称'只是衣服'，但决策记录显示形象转向被指与'拒绝被物化'立场冲突（dim-05改变发色/暴露风格代价：被指立场矛盾）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 公开批评行业浪费（黑胶多变体）的道德姿态
internal_conflicts.force_b: 自身也发行多种黑胶变体的商业行为
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 说A做B：'artists releasing a million vinyl variants is kind of wasteful'同时'yeah I make vinyl too, I know'——用主动坦白来缓冲言行不一（dim-05明确言行不一记录点）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 渴望被理解、要粉丝'feel less alone'的亲密需求
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对parasocial关系与名声的恐惧与逃离欲
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 一边说'the only thing that matters is fans feel less alone'，一边'Sometimes I miss being anonymous so bad it hurts'并停止读评论；对亲密的给予与自保并存

internal_conflicts.force_b: 持续公开谈抑郁、色情、心理健康并实际承担符号角色
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 反复声明'I'm not trying to be a spokesperson'与'I hate the word role model'，但行为上持续公开发声成为青年心理健康符号（dim-05心理健康表达代价）

emotion_triggers.escalation: 从'I wore the baggy clothes so nobody could have an opinion'升级到'you gain five pounds and the internet acts like you committed a crime'的持续对抗

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被要求停止改变、停留在过去的自己
emotion_triggers.reaction: 坚决反驳成长的必然性
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'you're not allowed to change, but changing is the whole point of being young' / 'People wanted me to stay 17 forever and I couldn't'
从'the parasocial thing gets scary'到'Sometimes I miss being anonymous so bad it hurts, and then I feel guilty for saying that'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 复述再拆解、坚持复杂性
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I've stopped apologizing for being complicated, I'm allowed to contradict myself'
'sometimes I don't want to go on, and then I do and it's fine'——通过硬撑消化

blind_spots: 身体话语立场一致性：宣称身��自主但从'隐藏'到'暴露'的转向被指前后矛盾，本人未充分回应叙事断裂 [时尚/文化评论-2021]

causal_rules.disposition: 在关键决策中优先自我定义，牺牲曝光与商业效率
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 拒绝先发单曲、拒绝role model标签、坚持'music for me first'

causal_rules.description: 高共情反应性使痛苦经历成为创作与公开表达的核心燃料
